possible_outcomes: Maintain fewer than 12 validated score-bank items and NO-GO on the revised launch until content quality passes
Develop and retest truly distinct contexts with balanced choices, without assuming ideas above are novel factors
If 12-item-bank with max-two proves untenable, escalate formal requirement conflict for owner decision; do not relax the user's cap autonomously
caveat: Some current 13 family hypotheses may themselves be near-duplicates or not valid. Eleven is a theoretical lower bound assuming all current group distinctions survive, not a claim that eleven valid new factors have been identified.
